description: Lightning F.53K 53-415 (c/n 95308, ex G-27-83), code H. One of three F.53Ks mounted in vic formation on poles near the main gate inside Ahmed Al Jaber Air Base, with 53-416 and 53-417 (Thunder & Lightnings, photo June 1995 Roy Hauer; AirHistory.net photo 2016; Flickr 2016). Scramble reports the trio was damaged in a 2018 windstorm; condition since then unknown. Left aircraft of the trio per serial order.

Lightning F.53K 53-416, code J, serial painted in Arabic numerals. One of the three-ship memorial near the main gate inside Ahmed Al Jaber Air Base (AirHistory.net photo 218660, 2016; Thunder & Lightnings; Flickr 2016). Damaged in a 2018 windstorm per Scramble; current condition unknown.

Lightning F.53K 53-417 (c/n 95310), code K. One of the three-ship memorial near the main gate inside Ahmed Al Jaber Air Base (AirHistory.net 2016; Thunder & Lightnings; Flickr 2016). Damaged in a 2018 windstorm per Scramble; current condition unknown.
